archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY (Agriculture, Fresh Produce & Tribal Heritage)

theme_strategy.description: Lush forest greenery paired with warm, rich terracotta earth tones, balanced with soft warm cream canvas backgrounds. Subtly infused with digitized Chhattisgarh Bastar tribal geometric art motifs on section borders, header accents, and footers.

bastar_art_integration.cultural_notes: Bastar tribal art (Godna and traditional Panika handloom patterns) relies on geometric chevrons, diamond lattices, stylized arrows, and sun/leaf symbols rendered in ochre red and deep forest green.

layout_and_bento.storefront_hero_mode: Tetris Grid - Left prominent hero card with live farm highlights, right stacked feature cards (Fresh Harvest, Organic Spawn Kits, Tribal Farmer Support).
layout_and_bento.storefront_spacing: Generous spacing philosophy: section padding py-16 lg:py-24, component gap gap-8 lg:gap-12.
layout_and_bento.dashboard_mode: High Density Grid (4-column layout) with sticky header, dark forest sidebar (#0F2E23), tight padding p-4 to p-6.
layout_and_bento.card_padding_rule: Containers with borders must have internal padding p-6 or p-8 to prevent text collision.

bilingual_support.implementation: React Context / State switcher with seamless UI updates across storefront & admin.

instructions_to_main_agent: Always apply data-testid to every interactive component (e.g. data-testid='add-to-cart-btn-1', data-testid='checkout-razorpay-radio').
Use standard icons from lucide-react (Sprout, ShoppingBag, Truck, AlertTriangle, ChevronRight, Package, TrendingUp, ShieldCheck).
Ensure the English / Hindi toggle dynamically translates key storefront strings, tabs, status badges, and checkout steps.
For Razorpay payments, simulate a clean modal overlay step with payment options, and fallback to Cash on Delivery with immediate order confirmation.
In the Admin dashboard, maintain low stock alerts (< 15 kg/units) highlighted with warning badges and quick 'Reorder Spawn/Substrate' action buttons.
Incorporate the Bastar SVG pattern subtle border on card tops, footer dividers, and hero banners to showcase Chhattisgarh heritage seamlessly.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Do not center align the entire body. Avoid flat gray text on light backgrounds without proper contrast. Use layered shadows and warm cream cards.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.grid_children_rule: Ensure grid items are direct children. When using framer-motion, set class name directly on motion.div.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.testing_rule: All interactive buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and status badges MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
